ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is triangle LMN, and side LM and side MN both have identical double tick marks, indicating LM = MN. At point L, the angle between ray LN and LM is labeled 20°. Reasoning: Because △LMN is an isosceles triangle, and the equal sides are LM and MN, the base is LN, and base angles ∠MLN and ∠LNM are equal. It is known that ∠MLN = 20°, therefore ∠LNM = 20°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so ∠M = 180° - 20° - 20° = 140°.
